clue.text: Ancient Rome retrospective in Mail? I'm confused

explanation.walkthrough: 'Mail' looks like the newspaper, but it is just letters for the jumble, and the question mark flags that cheek.
explanation.definitionFit: Something immemorial is so old that it goes back beyond human memory or record.

clue.text: Vocal star getting no work?

explanation.definitionFit: An unemployed person or a machine not in use is idle, without occupation.

clue.text: Fashion bags are height of devotion

taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'Fashion' is a verb here, MINT as in striking coins, not style.
explanation.definitionFit: A minaret is the tall tower of a mosque from which the call to prayer is made, a lofty point of worship.

clue.text: Egypt's ultimate character could be seen as this?

definitions.text: Egypt's ultimate character could be seen as this?

parts.words: Egypt's ultimate character could be seen as this

explanation.definitionFit: Egypt lies in the region spanning south-west Asia and north-east Africa, so its nature is that of that part of the world.

clue.text: Builds up banks again?

explanation.definitionFit: An airer is a rack or frame on which washing is hung to dry while it drips.

clue.text: Prepare to take off tariff required by India

clue.text: Site of 1836 battle, with Germany and Spain giving in

clue.text: During edit, fine novel becomes confused

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Trace backfiring old truck that's full of rusty metal

clue.text: Force home what railway security should do?

explanation.definitionFit: Read as an instruction, the phrase means to patrol and guard the stopping places of trains.

clue.text: Vehicle in which one drives a short distance back to front

definitions.text: Vehicle in which one drives a short distance back to front

someone suffering is ill

explanation.definitionFit: A standstill is a halt where all movement has come to a stop.

clue.text: Treated badly, after time showing tears?

badly says the letters of treated are put in a poor order

explanation.surface: Someone mistreated and, eventually, crying.

explanation.definitionFit: Tattered cloth is ragged and torn, full of rips.

clue.text: Sincere upset after I dropped present

explanation.definitionFit: To screen a film or programme is to show or broadcast it to viewers.

clue.text: In revolutionary havoc, serf lashed out

indicators.note: revolutionary says the hidden letters are read backwards
In says the answer sits inside the words that follow, spanning them

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.definitionFit: Doing something al fresco means doing it outdoors in the open air.

clue.text: One's keen to take off on holiday

definitions.text: One's keen to take off on holiday

parts.words: One's keen to take off on holiday

clue.text: Lower rent a small amount

clue.text: Bonus I'm assembling for collection

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Fall short ahead of a popular home fixture

clue.text: Found ducks a home for 24?
